set.tovw: Lead grade D (treasure thread): one Chicago story and its reprints; local paper doubted it

tw-mi-bertrand-bushel.st: The Niles Daily Star (5 Dec 1898) doubted it: the tale came from the Sunday Chicago Chronicle and no one locally had heard of it.
src: Niles Daily Star 5 Dec 1898 p3 (newspapers.com 1020495798, PC (a))

tw-mi-south-fox-dishpans.st: An older, different version (Grand Rapids Herald, 7 Oct 1887, from Northport): a dying sailor told a Cleveland doctor that he and a companion stole $15,000 in gold from a vessel and buried it on South Fox in the Mormon years. By the 1880s the spot was said to be on a farm, not far from the farmhouse, and an assistant lighthouse keeper meant to dig there.
src: Grand Rapids Herald 7 Oct 1887 p1 (newspapers.com 864632180, PC (a))
